mechanism: Tolterodine is metabolized by CYP2D6 and CYP3A4; valsartan may inhibit CYP3A4, potentially increasing tolterodine levels, combined with additive anticholinergic and hypotensive effects.
action: Monitor blood pressure and anticholinergic adverse effects; consider dose adjustment of tolterodine if hypotension or urinary retention occurs; ensure adequate renal function monitoring.
